{{Top|leg}}
'''Azzi''' was the [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] of Modern History at the academy on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] attended by [[Conn Doruggan]]. An opponent of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Azzi was not impressed by Doruggan's last-minute essay on Human Expansionism.
